package http3

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestTunnelReceiveQueueBurstAndRingReuse(t *testing.T) {
	s := &stateTrackingStream{hasData: make(chan struct{}, 1)}
	if TunnelDatagramQueueCapacity != 256 { t.Fatal("unexpected compiled tunnel queue capacity") }
	for cycle := 0; cycle < 4; cycle++ {
		for i := 0; i < streamDatagramQueueLen+1; i++ { s.enqueueDatagram([]byte{byte(i), byte(cycle)}) }
		if s.queueSize != streamDatagramQueueLen { t.Fatal("receive queue is not bounded") }
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
		for i := 0; i < streamDatagramQueueLen; i++ {
			got, err := s.ReceiveDatagram(ctx)
			if err != nil || len(got) != 2 || got[0] != byte(i) || got[1] != byte(cycle) { t.Fatalf("FIFO mismatch cycle=%d packet=%d got=%v error=%v", cycle, i, got, err) }
		}
		cancel()
		if s.queueSize != 0 { t.Fatal("receive queue did not drain") }
		for _, retained := range s.queue { if retained != nil { t.Fatal("popped datagram retained by ring") } }
	}
}
